method: Physical neutral eye/boot baseline and constant combat clip scale from authored upright first/last guards. Independent head/body proportion and facial-pixel checks reject bad source anatomy; facial style matching never enlarges the standing body. Other actions retain constant source-head calibration; walking cannot exceed standing stature by more than 2 percent. No per-frame scaling, head edits or body warps.
